title: The Stopped Sundial
text: In an overgrown garden stands a sundial whose shadow never moves. It is always the same golden, drowsy hour of late afternoon here. The roses never fade, and bees hang still in the air above them.

options.label: Rest in the golden garden, where no hour is ever lost.

outcomes.text: You rest a long time, though no time passes at all.

options.label: The Leader turns the dial to set the garden's time going again.

outcomes.text: Time starts again. The garden blooms and the bees fly.
Time starts again all at once, and the Leader feels every hour of it.

options.label: The strongest wrenches out the gnomon; stopped time is worth something.

outcomes.text: The old bronze hums with stopped hours. Behind you, the roses begin to brown.
